fields.Property Note:
The property to be sold is located in the OLD BRIDGE TOWNSHIP in the County of
MIDDLESEX, and the State of New Jersey.
Tax Lot 4 C0263 Block 2150 f/k/a Lot 266 Block 2150.38
Commonly known as 21 Catherine Court, South Amboy (Old Bridge Township), New Jersey 08879
Dimensions of the Lot are (Approximately)
Unit No. 266 in Building No. 38, together with an undivided 0.25839% Deed Shows .79365% interest (6th amendments refers to the percentage interest change) in the Common Elements is located substantially as delineated in the Master Deed for "Bridgepointe Condominium", as recorded in the Office of the Clerk of Middlesex County on June 18, 1990 in Book 3859 of Deeds at Page 1, and as amended by Deed Book
4042, Page 643; Deed Book 4884, Page 696; Deed Book 4904, Page 128; Deed Book 4933, Page 685; Deed Book 5005, Page 511; Deed Book 5041, Page 381 and Deed Book 5871, Page 25; and any amendments thereto.
The sale is subject to unpaid taxes and assessments, tax, water and sewer liens and other
municipal assessments. The amount due can be obtained from the local taxing authority.
Pursuant to NJSA 46:8B-21 the sale may also be subject to the limited lien priority of any
condominium/homeowner association liens which may exist. The sale may be further
subject to Restrictions, reversions, reservations, and easements of record. The occupancy
status of the subject property is unknown.
The approximate upset sum is $529,286.03 calculated through October 5, 2026 plus any additional advance, interest, sheriff's cost and commision to the date of sale.
